# Retheme Portal CSS and PortalHeader with Brand Palette

## Context

- The portal app uses a custom Web Awesome theme defined in two CSS files:
  - `apps/portal/src/main/resources/static/src/styles/portal.css` — the **active** file processed by Vite, with correct bare-specifier imports. This is the file to edit.
  - `apps/portal/src/main/resources/static/public/portal.css` — an older copy in `public/`. **Do not edit this file.**
- The theme class is `.wa-theme-portal` and is applied to `<html>` in `index.html`.
- The theme has three rule blocks:
  1. **Light** — selectors like `.wa-theme-portal`, `.wa-theme-portal.wa-light`, etc.
  2. **Dark** — selectors like `.wa-theme-portal.wa-dark`, `.wa-dark .wa-theme-portal`, etc.
  3. **Shared / Design tokens** — fonts, spacing, borders, rounding, focus, shadows, transitions, component vars.
- `PortalHeader.ts` lives at `apps/portal/src/main/resources/static/src/components/PortalHeader.ts` and uses `--portal-header-bg` custom property for its background, with a `--wa-color-surface-raised` fallback.
- The header renders a `[part="header"]` element. Its CSS is inside the `styles: [...]` array of `defineCustomElement`.

## Objective

Replace the color token values in `src/styles/portal.css` with the new brand palette and update `PortalHeader.ts` to use the primary green as a gradient background.

## Brand Palette

| Role | Value |
|---|---|
| Primary text | `#FCE9C8` (warm cream) |
| Primary / brand base | `#194430` (dark forest green) |
| Primary light | `#528C5C` |
| Primary lighter | `#6D9B6D` |
| Secondary | Derived from primary variants — choose a complementary earthy tone (e.g. warm amber/gold: `#C49A3C`) |

## Requirements

- [ ] Edit only `src/styles/portal.css` — **not** `public/portal.css`
- [ ] Do **not** add or rename any CSS custom property keys — only change their values
- [ ] Define values for **all three** theme contexts: light, dark, and the shared token block
- [ ] Derive missing palette steps (e.g. `--wa-color-brand-10` through `--wa-color-brand-95`) from the brand base `#194430` as a consistent green scale with proper light/dark brightness distribution
- [ ] Light theme: lighter surfaces (off-white / cream-tinted), dark text, primary green accents
- [ ] Dark theme: deep green-black surfaces (derived from `#194430` darkened), cream/warm text, brighter green accents
- [ ] Update `PortalHeader.ts` `--portal-header-bg` to use a linear gradient from the primary base to the primary-light variant; also update the nav bar color to be slightly lighter or offset from the header bar
- [ ] `pnpm exec vite build` must pass with no errors after changes

## Technical Specifications

- File: `src/styles/portal.css`
- File: `src/components/PortalHeader.ts`
- Pattern: CSS custom properties only — no new selectors, no new property names
- Surface token semantics:
  - `surface-raised` = highest elevation (header, cards)
  - `surface-default` = base page background
  - `surface-lowered` = inset / recessed areas
  - `surface-border` = subtle separator color
- Text token semantics:
  - `text-normal` = primary readable text
  - `text-quiet` = muted / secondary text
  - `text-link` = interactive link color
- Brand token semantics:
  - `brand-fill-quiet / normal / loud` = fill intensities
  - `brand-border-quiet / normal / loud` = border intensities
  - `brand-on-quiet / normal / loud` = text on top of fills
- Gradient for header: `linear-gradient(135deg, #194430 0%, #528C5C 100%)` — adjust stops as needed for visual quality

## Constraints

- Do not change any `@import` statements
- Do not add new CSS layers or selectors
- Do not change any property names — values only
- Neutral color scale (`--wa-color-neutral-*`) should use grey-green tones that complement the brand palette
- Focus color (`--wa-color-focus`) must remain accessible (sufficient contrast against both light and dark surfaces)
- All color values must be valid CSS (hex, rgb, color-mix, or var references)

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `src/styles/portal.css` compiles through Vite without errors
- [ ] Light theme: cream/off-white surfaces, `#1a2e1e`-ish dark text, green accents
- [ ] Dark theme: deep green-black surfaces (`#0d1a12` range), warm cream text (`#FCE9C8`), bright green accents
- [ ] Header displays a green gradient background (primary → primary-light)
- [ ] Nav bar is visually distinct from but harmonious with the header bar
- [ ] No property keys added, removed, or renamed in `portal.css`
- [ ] `pnpm exec vite build` passes

## Examples

```css
/* Light surface example */
--wa-color-surface-raised: #f5f0e8;    /* cream-tinted white */
--wa-color-surface-default: #ede8dc;   /* slightly deeper cream */
--wa-color-text-normal: #1a2e1e;       /* dark green-black */
--wa-color-brand-fill-loud: #194430;   /* primary green fill */
--wa-color-brand-on-loud: #FCE9C8;     /* cream text on green */

/* Dark surface example */
--wa-color-surface-raised: #152b1e;    /* dark green surface */
--wa-color-surface-default: #0d1a12;   /* deepest green-black */
--wa-color-text-normal: #FCE9C8;       /* cream text */
--wa-color-brand-fill-loud: #528C5C;   /* lighter green in dark mode */

/* Header gradient (PortalHeader.ts) */
--portal-header-bg: linear-gradient(135deg, #194430 0%, #528C5C 100%);
--portal-header-nav-bg: #1e3828;       /* slightly lighter than base */
```

## Additional Notes

- The `public/portal.css` file has broken relative imports and is not processed by Vite — it exists as a legacy artifact. Ignore it entirely.
- The shared token block (fonts, spacing, borders, shadows, transitions) should remain **unchanged** — only the color blocks need updating.
- After editing `portal.css`, also update the `styles` array in `PortalHeader.ts` to hardcode the gradient for `--portal-header-bg` and set `--portal-header-nav-bg` to a matching dark-green value. These override the `--wa-color-surface-*` fallbacks.
- Ensure the cream text color `#FCE9C8` has sufficient contrast against the dark green gradient background for WCAG AA compliance.
